name: account.retoken
description: Keeps an account's new sealed tokens after a refresh, only if the brand still holds that same account. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: update brandbase.accounts a set tokens = :tokens, updated_at = now() where a.brand_id = :brand and a.platform = :platform and a.account_id = :accountId returning jsonb_build_object('accountId', a.account_id) as result
